programme.title: Charlie O Alfabeto Inglês
programme.desc: Em cada episódio, o Charlie conhece um dos seus amigos do alfabeto. Juntos embarcam numa aventura e ajudam-se mutuamente. A série introduz as letras do alfabeto às crianças e a sua fonética, identificando assim as palavras que iniciam com estas letras.

programme.title: O Mundo De Charlie
programme.desc: O Mundo de Charlie é uma encantadora série musical, concebida para criar um mundo de diversão e aprendizagem para os jovens espetadores. Envolta em música animada e enérgica, a série centra-se nas aventuras divertidas de Charlie e dos muitos amigos que encontra pelo caminho desde elefantes e cavalos até bolas falantes e números

programme.title: Pierre, O Pintor
programme.desc: Pierre, um pintor apaixonado, conhece crianças e pinta uma imagem com elas. Quando começa a desenhar, as crianças tentam adivinhar o que ele está a pintar. O Pierre continua a adicionar pistas à imagem até que a criança consiga adivinhar o desenho do Pierre.

programme.title: O Meu Robô E Eu
programme.desc: A série é sobre a relação especial entre uma menina curiosa e cheia de energia, Kim, e o seu novo robô, a quem dá o nome de Kit. Para Kit, tudo é novo e Kim acredita que tem muito para lhe ensinar, mas descobre que tem tanto a aprender quanto ele.

programme.title: Gee-raffa
programme.desc: Conheça a Raffa - um tipo de girafa sensível que está sempre disposta a ajudar o próximo. É por isso que os amigos da Raffa a encontram sempre quando necessitam da sua ajuda - quando perdem algo, quando estão tristes, quando necessitam de aprender a dançar, ou até mesmo quando não conseguem adormecer. Os seus bons amigos sabem que podem contar com o apoio da Raffa para resolver os seus problemas com imenso entusiasmo e humor.

programme.title: Walter Dude
programme.desc: O Dude não se lembra do que procura. Ainda bem que o seu amigo Walter está sempre lá para ajudar. Ouça como o par descreve cada artigo e veja se pode adivinhar o que é.

programme.desc: Um objeto, tão familiar, do dia a dia chega à porta de Zeina esquecendo-se da sua utilidade. Ao procurarem a resposta, Zeina e o seu melhor amigo Roy inventam um novo uso hilariante para o objeto surpreendido. Enquanto todos se divertem imenso com a sua nova utilidade, é-lhes revelado o verdadeiro uso do objeto.

programme.title: A Bicicleta Do Mike
programme.desc: A oficina de bicicletas do Mike é um lugar onde todos vão quando têm um problema para resolver. Seja grande ou pequeno, o Mike está sempre lá para ajudar os seus amigos com as suas invenções únicas, peculiares e engraçadas, que colocam um sorriso no rosto de todos. A série coloca a frase se não conseguires à primeira, volta a tentar outra vez vezes sem conta sob outra perspectiva.

programme.title: Mona Sketch
programme.desc: Mona é uma menina aventureira com um amigo muito especial chamado Sketch. Mona utiliza a sua imaginação para pensar no que ela quer ser e o Sketch ajuda-a com as suas habilidades artísticas.

programme.title: Billy Bam Bam
programme.desc: Billy and Bam Bam é um show energético e emocionante com pequenos e fofos irmãos peludos que gostam de descobrir ideias sem fim de atividades imaginativas e inspiradoras, brincando com objetos cotidianos que encontram em casa e no parque - um rolo de papel pode-se tornar num comboio pouca terra, tampas de panela podem-se tornar instrumentos musicais - tocando juntos, cantando e se divertindo como os irmãos fazem.

programme.title: Bando Dos Amiguinhos
programme.desc: A Borboleta Baby e os seus amigos animais recordam os momentos divertidos que passaram juntos, como o dia em que foram à praia, fizeram truques de magia, ou brincaram numa banda Eles resolvem os seus problemas, porque sabem que sua amizade é o mais importante

programme.title: Bath Tubbies
programme.desc: O Sapinho pesca um baú O que estará lá dentro Roupas de fantasia Vê o Patinho vestido de nativo americano, a Ellie de palhaço e o Sapinho de leão Junta-te aos amigos para uma festa de fantasia

programme.title: Olha O Que Encontrei
programme.desc: Uma criança entra num quarto e descobre um objeto doméstico. A história desenrola no quarto assim como na imaginação do menino, onde cada objeto se transforma em algo divertido e surpreendente. Um sapato transforma-se num carro, um pedaço de papel num avião e muito mais A série apresenta-nos a interação com pequenos objetos a par com a imaginação da criança, que pode transformar um objeto em algo maior do que a vida

programme.title: Cuddlies
programme.desc: O quarteto favorito da BabyTV, os Cuddlies, apresenta uma série de histórias divertidas do mundo dos mais pequenos. Junta-te aos nossos adoráveis amiguinhos e aprende o que é a colaboração, a partilha e o carinho, enquanto os quatro se ajudam mutuamente a resolver dilemas simples de uma forma divertida e amigável.

programme.desc: Fecha os olhos, encosta-te e relaxa. Está na hora de ires para a cama.

programme.title: Galicia Enxebre Com David Arcay T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Joselo, amante da pesca de caranguejos, tem dedicado parte da sua vida a reparar armadilhas antigas para a pesca de caranguejos. Repara armadilhas para os seus amigos e depois, uma vez aberta a época, desfruta do seu trabalho passando dias inesquecíveis.

programme.title: As Carpas De Jose
programme.desc: Nas praias do Puerto de Santa María, o surfcasting é vivido como tradição e paixão. O ambiente natural, com a sua areia fina e mar aberto, oferece um cenário privilegiado para este desporto. O reportagem mostra tanto a técnica como as histórias pessoais de quem o pratica. Mais do que pesca, é uma experiência de convívio e respeito pelo mar gaditano.

programme.title: Perdiceros En El Bonillo
programme.desc: Es historia viva de la caza, una de las figuras cinegéticas más queridas y respetadas. Ismael Tragacete se sienta a charlar con nuestra presentadora de Play Caza, Beatriz Rosete, sobre su inmensa trayectoria de caza y competición, sobre todo en caza menor con perro donde tiene un palmarés de oro. Anécdotas, vivencias, risas y confidencias de un cazador que a sus 81 años sigue en activo, todo un referente para las nuevas generaciones.

programme.title: Surfcasting No Puerto De Santa María
programme.desc: Viajamos a las montañas leonesas con los hermanos Lestrade, que decidieron celebrar el 80 aniversario de Michel cazando un rebeco cantábrico y descubriendo las bondades de la cocina montañesa.

programme.title: Play Caza T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Através de um dos criadores mais reconhecidos de podengos manetos vamos conhecer esta pequena mas grande raça para a caça ao coelho. Estes apaixonados pela espécie souberam aliar beleza e trabalho nas suas linhas conseguindo grandes trunfos quer na competição de beleza como a caçar no campo com os seus exemplares.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivencias De Un Guía De Caza T6 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: El coto de Viana do Bolo se encuentra en la provincia de Orense, muy cerca de la frontera con Portugal y de las provincias de León y Zamora. Con grandes montes de castaño y roble el jabalí tiene asegurada la comida, permitiendo grandes batidas con muy buenos resultados.

programme.title: Boreale, Vivencias De Un Guía De Caza T6 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Es historia viva de la caza, una de las figuras cinegéticas más queridas y respetadas. Ismael Tragacete se sienta a charlar con nuestra presentadora de Play Caza, Beatriz Rosete, sobre su inmensa trayectoria de caza y competición, sobre todo en caza menor con perro donde tiene un palmarés de oro. Anécdotas, vivencias, risas y confidencias de un cazador que a sus 81 años sigue en activo, todo un referente para las nuevas generaciones.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Duas jornadas apaixonantes de caça atrás da perdiz selvagem com o campeão de Zamora, David Pascual. Perdizes silvestres num terreno muito carregado de água que lhes vai exigir esforço extra para poderem alcança-las, num ano onde as perdizes mostraram uma força incrível.

programme.title: Barbos Com Frutos Vermelhos
programme.desc: O ojeo de perdiz é uma modalidade cinegética exclusiva de Espanha. Na zona de La Mancha são levadas a cabo excelentes caçadas, onde participam caçadores de toda a parte do mundo, maravilhados pelo voo e bravura das perdizes vermelhas.

programme.title: Perdiz A Salto Em Fuentespreadas
programme.desc: El cobro forzado es un recurso que debemos conocer en profundidad y saber cuándo y cómo aplicarlo si nuestros perros no logran cobrar de forma natural.

programme.title: Ojeos De Perdiz, Marca Espanha
programme.desc: Conhecemos a montanha palentina no seu pleno esplendor com Pablo, da Travesía Rural, com o qual estaremos a disfrutar das suas duas grandes paixões, a recolha de cogumelos e a pesca com mosca em alta montanha.

programme.title: Adiestrando Para La Caza T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas. Caza menor con perros de grouses o pequeños urogallos, o en puestos de patos, barnaclas o gansos blancos.

programme.title: Trutas Palentinas
programme.desc: La gastroacuaponía es una forma diferente de entender la cocina. Una actividad que integra y fusiona gastronomía con acuaponía.

programme.title: Súper Mario Boss T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: El rio Suarna es uno de esos viveros naturalescon una alta densidad de truchas en todos sus tramos. Aquí queremos sacar peces de talla..

programme.desc: En este ultimo capitulo, nuestro experto arquero nos enseña como fabricar uno de los elementos más importantes para apuntar bien. El loop.

programme.title: Caçadores De Javalis T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Um grupo de adeptos da caça ao javali mostra-nos como é que caçam a espécie à espera na região da serra Magina e mais concretamente no municipio de Belmez, onde os suinos provovam graves danos na agricultura.

programme.desc: Segunda parte de la monteria celebrada en el Coto Nieblas donde 11 monteros ubicados en torretas disfrutaron de los lances a venados, gamos, muflones y jabalies.

programme.title: Moçambique, Paraíso Do Popping E Do Jigging
programme.desc: En este ultimo capitulo, nuestro experto arquero nos enseña como fabricar uno de los elementos más importantes para apuntar bien. El loop.

programme.title: Quebec A Vista De Pájaro T13 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Este episodio adquiere un carácter especialmente simbólico al conectar con la historia familiar, ya que fue su abuelo quien, por mandato de Alfonso XIII, impulsó la creación del Real Parque de Gredos. La experiencia en este entorno natural se presenta como un viaje emocional donde convergen paisaje, memoria e identidad.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: La pesca en los estuarios donde se mezcla el agua dulce con la salada se convierte en esta serie, en todo un reto para la pesca. Desde kayak o desde orilla, con lluvia o al final del verano, nuestros protagonistas nos mostrarán las mejores técnicas y las localizaciones más oportunas para disfrutar de las especies deportivas del litoral gallego.

programme.title: Spinning En Estuarios Gallegos T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: En este episodio, el enfoque se traslada al ámbito de la caza mayor, acompañamos a don Alonso a una montería en Extremadura. Aquí se muestra no solo la acción cinegética sino también todo lo que la rodea: la preparación, la relación con el campo, los valores de respeto por la naturaleza y el papel social de estas prácticas.

programme.title: O Atum De Ponta A Ponta T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: La pasión por el jabalí es también pasión por el perro y por las armas usadas en su caza. Allá donde haya jabalíes habrá cazadores volcados casi en exclusiva a esta especie, especializándose del mismo modo en razas de perros y en equipos adecuados.

programme.title: Monteando Entre Robles Y Chaparros
programme.desc: Viajamos até ao deserto de Chihuahua no México, na companhia de Josemaria Losa à procura de uma das espécies mais apreciadas que habita a zona, para um caçador de montanha, o desert big horn, ou borrego cimarron, esta e outras espécies deste deserto cheio de vida farão desta viagem uma experiência inesquecível.

programme.title: Wild Ibex - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os ibex de Beceite. Wild Ibex Una apasionante serie que recoge las vivencias de cazadores extranjeros que vienen a España en busca del emblemático y desafiante macho montés. Seremos testigos de cuatro travesías, cargadas de vibrantes momentos.

programme.desc: Na Ronda Wildfire, os chefs tentam não ceder à pressão. É Lutar ou Fugir na Ronda Crossfire e, na Ronda Feast of Fire, o júri recebe a verdadeira hospitalidade sulista.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: A Ronda Wildfire permite aos chefs servirem grandes sabores, grandes personalidades… e grandes erros. A Ronda Crossfire dá um abanão aos concorrentes e, no Feast of Fire, os chefs estão em chamas para agradar e ganhar dez mil dólares.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A família Higgins está à procura de um cachorrinho que se encaixe no seu estilo de vida divertido e ativo. Quem vai ter a palavra final na escolha entre o weimaraner, o terrier tibetano e o caniche miniatura?

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T3 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: A família Stoop quer adotar um cão para ser o companheiro do seu filho mais novo, o Tom. Ele tem de escolher entre um cruzado de Labrador retriever e border collie, um cruzado de collie e Labrador retriever e um cruzado de border collie e pastor alemão.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T3 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Mary prepara acompanhamentos indulgentes que se destacam ao lado de um bom bife, como Batata Recheada com Camarão Scampi ou Cogumelos Recheados de duas maneiras.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T3 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Tenham uma surpresa nutritiva com as receitas da Mary que incluem coisas saudáveis sem poupar no sabor.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes visita a atriz Vera Kolodzig e surpreende-a com uns Filetes de Pescada com Arroz de Tomate e Pimentos. Enquanto Fátima cozinha, Vera revela a liberdade de ser fiel a si própria e ao seu propósito de contribuir para um mundo mais verde.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes vai a casa de Mónica Jardim para lhe preparar um reconfortante Caril de Legumes. No conforto do seu espaço, a apresentadora revela a sua energia positiva e vitalidade contagiante, mostrando como manter o sorriso mesmo perante os desafios da vida.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A primeira casa do solteiro Kyle é bonita, mas também pequena. O pai, Jack, ajudou-o a renovar o interior, mas o quintal continua vazio e inutilizável.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Becki, Shawn e os três filhos mudaram-se da cidade para o campo. A casa é encantadora, mas pequena. Para aumentar o espaço habitável desta família em crescimento, Brian e Sarah constroem um novo deck com pérgula, uma zona para fogueira e um espaço de estar utilizável durante três estações do ano.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Os Baeumler tentam viver em metade da sua casa, à medida que iniciam a renovação. O seu âmbito de trabalho é alargado.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Bryan trata dos projetos da época baixa no hotel com um ajudante especial, enquanto Sarah começa a definir o seu novo capítulo na Florida.

programme.title: Prova De Amizade T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Ganhar as pistas para descobrirem quem são os convidados deste jantar, exige dos chefs muita pontaria e alguma batota. Fechando os olhos às regras, descobrem que vão cozinhar para o César Mourão e a Isabela Valadeiro.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Programa de viagens gastronómicas apresentado por Verónica Zumalacárregui que nos traz a cozinha de cidades de todo o mundo ao entrar em contacto com os protagonistas locais que acabam por funcionar como cicerones de exceção. Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Hanói (Vietname).

programme.title: Jiu Jitsu
programme.desc: De seis em seis anos, uma antiga ordem de mestres de Jiu Jitsu une forças para enfrentar e derrotar perigosos invasores alienígenas. Mas quando o derradeiro lutador da Terra é derrotado pelo líder dos invasores, o futuro do planeta e da humanidade fica em jogo...

programme.title: Sem Hora Marcada
programme.desc: Uma jovem a tirar fotografias na natureza testemunha sem querer o assassínio de um traficante por uma polícia e vê-se envolvida numa conspiração que envolve agentes corruptos. Em fuga pela vida, a única pessoa que lhe pode valer é um velho oficial reformado.

programme.title: Sobreviver Ao Jogo
programme.desc: Quando uma rusga para apanhar traficantes de droga corre mal, um polícia é ferido e o seu parceiro persegue os dois criminosos até uma quinta que pertence a um veterano. Este junta-se aos dois oficiais mas com cada vez mais criminosos a chegarem ao local, é impossível prever quem vai sobreviver.

programme.title: Fim De Turno
programme.desc: Na zona de South Central em Los Angeles, os polícias Brian Taylor e Mike Zavala estabelecem uma poderosa amizade para garantir que regressam sempre ambos a casa no ´Fim do Turno´. Mas quando uma operação dá para o torto, tornam-se alvos a abater por um dos mais violentos carteis da região.

programme.title: Todo O Dinheiro Do Mundo
programme.desc: Quando o neto de 16 anos do homem mais rico do mundo, John Paul Getty, é raptado, a família recebe um pedido de resgate exorbitante, que o milionário se recusa a pagar. Com a vida do filho em jogo, Gail alia-se ao braço direito de Getty para tentar resolver a situação.

programme.title: As Brancas Montanhas Da Morte
programme.desc: Veterano de guerra, Jeremiah Johnson isola-se nas Montanhas Rochosas em busca de paz como caçador solitário. Aí aprende a sobreviver na natureza selvagem e constrói uma família — até a tragédia o transformar numa lenda viva, marcada por uma guerra sem fim contra os índios Crow.

programme.title: Heidi
programme.desc: Heidi, uma pequena órfã, vive uma alegre infância junto do avô nos Alpes Suíços. Até que um dia, a sua tia a leva para uma rica mansão de Frankfurt para ser dama de companhia de Clara, uma menina de cadeira de rodas. Embora de mundos muito diferentes, Clara e Heidi desenvolvem uma marcante amizade.

programme.title: Hércules Contra Sansão
programme.desc: Partindo de Ítaca, Hércules e Ulisses lançam-se ao mar para caçar o monstro marinho que está a matar os pescadores locais. Quando o barco naufraga, os aventureiros vão parar à Terra Santa, onde o semi-deus é confundido com Sansão, que é um homem procurado, e com o qual acabará por juntar forças.

programme.title: A Super Agente
programme.desc: Molly Morris é uma jovem detetive particular especializada em fotografar homens em flagrante delito com amantes, que é contratada pelo FBI para se infiltrar como estudante numa universidade.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: A 12 de agosto do ano 2000, o submarino russo Kursk afundou-se no Mar de Barents, num desastre foi muito agravado por negligência governamental. Enquanto os marinheiros lutam pela sobrevivência debaixo de água, as suas famílias esbarram em obstáculos políticos e na impossibilidade de salvá-los.

programme.title: Revolução (Sem) Sangue
programme.desc: Baseado em factos reais, eis a história de quatro jovens que seguem as suas rotinas diárias num regime ditatorial. Embora não se conhecessem, o dia 25 de Abril de 1974 trouxe-lhes um destino comum. O dia que mudou o rumo do país ditou também o fim das suas vidas.

programme.title: Caçadores De Recompensa
programme.desc: Um famoso caçador de recompensas reencontra o seu principal inimigo, um fora-da-lei e um jogador profissional que ele tinha enviado para a prisão anos antes.

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava é uma assassina a soldo de uma organização secreta, que viaja por todo mundo com a missão de abater alvos VIP. Quando um desses trabalhos corre mal, Ava é obrigada a lutar pela sua sobrevivência e a enfrentar os fantasmas do passado…

programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: Triângulo
programme.desc: Quando vários amigos partem de férias num iate, estão longe de sonhar com o que lhes vai acontecer: uma tempestade faz virar o barco e eles refugiam-se num navio envelhecido e abandonado, onde alguém parece estar a tentar caçá-los.

programme.title: Toro
programme.desc: Dois irmãos reencontram-se ao fim de dois anos: um deles tem estado preso, o outro roubou um perigoso recetador e agora estão ambos em fuga, juntamente com Diana, a filha menor do último, numa viagem pela Andaluzia violenta, mítica, agreste e selvagem.

programme.title: Os Segredos Que Ocultamos
programme.desc: Nos EUA, após a Segunda Guerra Mundial, uma refugiada romena reconstrói a vida com o marido americano mas ainda continua atormentada pela memória dos horrores do conflito, acabando por raptar um vizinho em busca de vingança pelos crimes de guerra hediondos que ela acredita que ele cometeu.

programme.title: Silk Road: Mercado Clandestino
programme.desc: A história verídica do jovem Ross Ulbricht, que criou o Silk Road, um posto de vendas não regulado na internet que rapidamente serviu de palco a um negócio de tráfico de drogas de milhões de dólares, e da perseguição sem quartel que lhe moveu o imprevisível agente Rick Bowden.

programme.title: Snow - Os Domínios Do Espelho
programme.desc: Certo dia o Rei Harald, que odeia magia, decide isolar todos os Mágicos nos Domínios do Espelho. Desta forma, a última esperança para o Universo da Magia, é Kiara. Ela terá de descobrir os seus verdadeiros poderes e salvar a sua família, todos os mágicos e a própria magia!

programme.title: Triângulo Da Tristeza
programme.desc: Um casal de modelos célebres embarca num cruzeiro luxuoso, com convidados muito ricos que fazem exigências loucas aos empregados, até que o barco naufraga e os passageiros se vêem encalhados numa ilha deserta, onde a hierarquia do barco sofre uma inesperada reviravolta.

programme.title: Cai Na Real, Corgi
programme.desc: Rex é um cão de raça Corgi, o mais amado pela rainha britânica. Um dia, perde-se da dona e mistura-se com um bando de cães de todo o género e sem um centésimo do seu pedigree… Só que nessa epopeia fora da proteção e luxo do palácio real, Rex vai apaixonar-se e encontrar a sua verdadeira natureza…

programme.title: Visões
programme.desc: Piloto profissional de uma companhia aérea de topo, Estelle vive uma vida perfeita com o seu marido Guillaume, até ao dia em que, num corredor do aeroporto, se cruza com Ana, uma fotógrafa com quem teve um romance apaixonado há 20 anos, e que a vai lançar numa espiral de pesadelos.

programme.title: Praxx Fim De Semana
programme.desc: Inverno, sexta-feira. Um grupo de jovens universitários parte para um fim de semana em São João da Cruz, para celebrar a sua ascensão na prestigiada Associação da Vida Académica. A diversão dos jovens acaba por dar lugar ao terror quando à noite, na Praia da Cruz, um ritual de praxe é levado ao limite.

programme.title: 13 Minutos
programme.desc: Quatro famílias numa cidade do centro dos EUA são testadas num único dia, quando um tornado devastador atinge a localidade. Quando a sirene toca, a comunidade tem apenas 13 minutos para chegar aos abrigos. Caminhos irão cruzar-se, vidas serão irreversivelmente alteradas, e a cidade será arrasada…

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

programme.title: Jogo Da Apanhada
programme.desc: Há trinta anos que um grupo de amigos de infância joga todos os anos a mesma partida de apanhada, sem regras nem fronteiras. Este ano estão decididos a apanhar o único que nunca foi tocado — e que planeia reformar-se invicto no dia do seu casamento.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 2: Hades
programme.desc: Anos após a espetacular fuga de Ray Breslin da prisão, um dos elementos da sua nova força de segurança de elite desaparece no interior de uma cadeia ilegal chamada Hades, onde os prisioneiros são forçados a lutar entre si. A única forma de o libertar vai ser entrar lá para dentro também.

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: Waxman O Atirador
programme.desc: Waxman é um ex-soldado das Forças Especiais que está agora a trabalhar como assassino para uma agência governamental ultrassecreta. Quando uma missão num arranha-céus em construção lhe corre terrivelmente mal, Waxman e o seu parceiro Clegg tornam-se os principais alvos a abater.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano: Debussy, Gershwin a.o.
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital as part of the 2023 edition of the Amiata Piano Festival. On the program are Claude Debussy’s Cello Sonata, L. 135; Allegro moderato from Camille Saint-Saëns’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in C minor, Op. 32; Allegro ma non troppo from Johannes Brahms’s Cello Sonata No. 1 in E minor, Op.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
programme.desc: Italian conductor Beatrice Venezi leads the Orchestre national de Metz Grand Est and the Choeur de l'Opéra-Théâtre de Metz Métropole in a performance of Giacomo Puccini’s tragic opera Madama Butterfly (1904). The story revolves around Cio-Cio-San, the young Japanese geisha ‘Butterfly’ who marries the visiting American officer Pinkerton. Faithfully awaiting his return, she cannot accept that Pinkerton has abandoned her.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93. Beethoven wrote the work in 1812 upon completion of his Symphony No. 7. The composer conducted the February 27, 1814 première at a concert in Vienna that also included a reprise performance of his Symphony No.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 6 BWV 1019
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No.6 BWV 1019 is the last of the set of sonatas that Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably while working as chapel master in Köthen. He presumably wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen And Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Metamorphosen (A Study for 23 Solo Strings) and Mozart's Requiem, K. 626. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg (soprano), Avery Amereau (contralto), Ben Bliss (tenor) and Anthony Robin Schneider (bass). Recorded at Severance Hall, Cleveland in March 2023.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 10, Op. 14/2 and Sonata No. 15, Op. 28 'Pastoral'. He continued the program with a performance of Frédéric Chopin's Nocturne Op. 9/1, Etude Op. 25/7, and Johannes Brahms's technically demanding 'Variations on a Theme by Paganini', Op. 35 (Book II).

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of 'Overture Rosamunde' (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, the Netherlands in 2015. Schubert initially composed the Overture for Georg Ernst von hofmann's play 'Die Zauberharfe' ('The Magic Harp'), which premiered on August 19, 1820.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: The Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester was founded in 1986 at the initiative of Claudio Abbado and has since become the world’s best youth orchestra. Named after the great composer, the programme is marked by the special relationship between the maestro and the young orchestra, as well as their special relationship to Gustav Mahler.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus To¨nshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Brahms - Clarinet Sonata No. 2, Op. 120
programme.desc: Written in 1894, the two Clarinet Sonatas, Op. 120 are the last chamber music pieces Johannes Brahms composed. In this performance at Het Groene Paviljoen in Baarn, the Netherlands, clarinetist Henk de Graaf and pianist Daniël Wayenberg play Brahms’s Clarinet Sonata No. 2 in E-flat major, Op. 120.

programme.title: J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 34, KV. 338
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky – Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Dutch violinist Simone Lamsma brings lyricism and fire to Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s virtuosic Violin Concerto, joining conductor Gianandrea Noseda and the London Symphony Orchestra. Tchaikovsky wrote the piece in 1878 on the shores of Lake Geneva, collaborating closely with his former student and lover, violinist Iosif Kotek.

programme.title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo.

programme.title: Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Novelletten, Op. 21. The eight pieces for piano that make up this song cycle are often performed separately. It bears a dedication to pianist Adolph Henselt.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics- II
programme.desc: This dance concert - performed in the languages of both music and movement - features, in addition to works by Liszt, some of the finest pieces of Hungary's national romanticism that served to inspire them, antecedents of sacred music reaching as far back as the Gregorian period and compositions by contemporaries who influenced Liszt: Paganini and Chopin. Liszt Mosaics is founded on three thematic pillars.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
programme.desc: On Saturday, August 27, 2016, OVG and Sinfonia Rotterdam presented a new Veerhavenconcert under the direction of Conrad van Alphen. As part of this annual event presented in the port of Rotterdam, the musicians perform on a floating stage, and audiences watch the show on the dock and on boats.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 And Elgar’s Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 36
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 94
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 55
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.desc: Uma garota comum se muda para um apartamento de uma família rica, cada uma com sérios problemas psicológicos e obsessões. Eles serão capazes de curar um ao outro?.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: R. Brecker, B. Wallace and Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Mr. Phone Bone
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Live in London
programme.desc: Legendary performer Tony Bennett made his debut appearance at London's iTunes Fest at the Roundhouse and this stellar performance features the multi-Grammy award winner performing his biggest hits, among them, 'The Best Is Yet To Come,' 'Fly Me to the Moon,' and his signature song 'I Left My Heart in San Francisco.'.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: What Is This Thing Called Love
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: My Funny Valentine
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: New Cool Collective - Melkweg, Amsterdam
programme.desc: New Cool Collective is one of the foremost Dutch jazz ensembles. Pioneering new blends of music styles since 1993, NCC has performed in various formations, from small combos to larger ensembles and even big bands! The ensemble’s high energy is cut out for the dance floors, as dance, Latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo all meet in a jazzy mix.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Three Cohens
programme.desc: They are three siblings, born in Israel, passed through New York, each leading brilliant careers. The youngest, Avishai, has established himself as one of the most original trumpet players of the moment, author of highly acclaimed albums on the ECM label. The second youngest, Anat, saxophonist and clarinetist, in love with Brazilian music and Benny Goodman, is one of the great 'jazzwomen' of today.

programme.title: Curtis Stigers - Fly Me To The Moon
programme.desc: The Danish Radio Big Band joins forces with American vocalist Curtis Stigers to celebrate Frank Sinatra's iconic concerts at The Sands Hotel in Las Vegas. Curtis Stigers and the big band present the most popular evergreens from the American songbook of the 1950s and 1960s, one of which is the classic that lend the concert its name: “Fly Me To The Moon”.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Taking It Back And Nobody
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: The Mel Lewis Orchestra live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Mel Lewis Orchestra was arguably the most influential big band since the swing era.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Kim Hoorweg at BIRD, Rotterdam
programme.desc: After Dutch singer Kim Hoorweg landed her first record contract from Universal Music at the age of 14, her musical career took off and she became a well-known name in the Netherlands jazz community. Famous artists such as Candy Dulfer, Raul Midón, Metropole Orkest, and Gino Vannelli, to name a few, have already performed with the singer on numerous occasions.

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Sonny Sharrock - Peanut
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía And Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1978, the famed Chicago Blues All Star Band put on an electrifying performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Mark Guiliana
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Rumble
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quintet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and his quintet performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Natalia M. King
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Münchner Klaviersommer: Eliane Elias Trio
programme.desc: There’s no question about it: with a Grammy for Best Latin Jazz Album for her recording ‘Made In Brazil’, seven previous Grammy nominations, four ‘Gold Disc Awards’, and three ‘Best Vocal Album Awards’ in Japan, Eliane Elias has taken her place in the pantheon of music giants. In her projects, Elias wears many hats: she serves as producer, composer, lyricist, arranger, pianist, and vocalist.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Carlinhos Brown
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: BIRDtv: Orlando Julius
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: De Plomb et de Charbon
programme.desc: 25 Nuances de docs À l’Est du Maroc, des hommes continuent de creuser dans les mines désaffectées datant du protectorat français. Pour survivre dans un monde en ruines, ils s’enfoncent sous le sol à la recherche de minerais épuisés. Du fond des gouffres, les rêves perdus de la mine continuent de hanter leur imaginaire…

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: En quelques minutes, un incendie peut avaler une maison, une forêt, des souvenirs, une vie entière. Chaque été, les feux gagnent en violence et laissent derrière eux bien plus que des paysages calcinés : des familles déplacées, des pompiers à bout, des villages traumatisés. Ces témoignages racontent ce moment où tout bascule, quand il faut fuir, sauver ce qu’on peut… et apprendre ensuite à survivre à l’après.

programme.title: Affaire Conclue
programme.desc: BEST OF AFFAIRE CONCLUE Julia Vignali accueillera et accompagnera les propriétaires d’objets lors de leur expertise par l’un de nos commissaires-priseurs. En accord avec l’estimation de l’expert, Julia Vignali remettra un Pass au propriétaire, précieux sésame pour se présenter en salle des ventes devant nos acheteurs.

programme.title: Le Jour du Seigneur
programme.desc: C’est une photo de classe comme toutes les autres : des enfants souriants, bras dessus, bras dessous, et leur enseignante, debout à leur côté… Pourtant, ce cliché est un exploit : ces élèves sont musulmans, juifs, chrétiens, et tous étudient dans une même école, en Israël, malgré la guerre qui sépare les uns et les autres. Il s’agit du Collège lassallien des Frères de Jaffa, au sud de Tel-Aviv.

programme.desc: En quelques minutes, un incendie peut avaler une maison, une forêt, des souvenirs, une vie entière. Chaque été, les feux gagnent en violence et laissent derrière eux bien plus que des paysages calcinés : des familles déplacées, des pompiers à bout, des villages traumatisés. Ces témoignages racontent ce moment où tout bascule, quand il faut fuir, sauver ce qu’on peut… et apprendre ensuite à survivre à l’après.

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Le syndrome de Gilles de la Tourette reste l’un des troubles neurologiques les plus mal connus et les plus caricaturés. Tics moteurs, cris, gestes involontaires, parfois insultes incontrôlées : derrière l’image souvent moquée, il y a surtout une réalité beaucoup plus complexe, faite d’angoisse, de fatigue, de honte parfois… mais aussi de force, de famille et de résistance au regard des autres.
